project_type: Django 5.2.9 + Django REST Framework 3.16.1 SQLite article collection site with Bootstrap templates and vanilla JavaScript
language: Python 3 with HTML, CSS, and browser JavaScript
build_system: pip requirements.txt; Django management commands; no frontend compile step
test_framework: Django unittest discovery via manage.py test; current articles/tests.py is empty and root scripts are not discovered by the Django test runner
verification_instructions: After each feature run python3 manage.py test articles.test_podcast_collection. Before hand-off run python3 manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run, python3 manage.py migrate --plan, python3 manage.py check, python3 manage.py test articles.test_podcast_collection, and python3 manage.py test. All HTTP, subprocess, ASR, AI, adapter, and clock calls must be mocked; use a temporary PODCAST_TEMP_ROOT and override_settings.
environment_constraints: Worktree is /usr/Project/article_collection_django; relative paths from workflow agents can resolve to /usr, so use absolute paths. Git reports dubious ownership unless commands use git -c safe.directory=/usr/Project/article_collection_django. The worktree already has many modified and untracked files; preserve them, do not clean/reset, do not stage broadly, and do not alter databases or systemd state. Baseline python3 manage.py test passed with 0 discovered tests and printed unrelated mail-script output.
contribution_requirements: Use only existing runtime dependencies and Python standard library. Do not add Celery, Redis, a queue, SSE/WebSocket, key files, persistent audio, real audio downloads, real ASR/AI calls, or systemd deployment actions. Keep ordinary anonymous article collection and its synchronous response behavior unchanged. New paid external work must require authentication and all public/admin representations must redact audio URLs, ASR IDs, provider payloads, temporary paths, headers, and credentials.
key_patterns: ArticleCollectionService in articles/services.py synchronously creates a CollectionTask then Article. ArticleViewSet and CollectionTaskViewSet are DRF routers in articles/views.py, serializers are model/Serializer classes in articles/serializers.py, routes are registered in articles/urls.py, and collect.html contains inline vanilla JS. Production config inherits settings.py in settings_production.py. Existing umeikouagent.service runs as nginx with production settings; the new worker must be a separate single-worker unit.
directory_structure: articles/ contains Django models, services, DRF code, admin, migrations, and management commands. article_collection_django/ contains settings. templates/articles/ and static/css/ contain the collection UI. Root contains requirements.txt, systemd units, and deployment documentation.
